description: Vaarwegbeheer - Vrijwaringszones vaarwegen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze data bevat vrijwaringszones langs de vaarwegen van de provincie Zuid-Holland. Vrijwaringszones zijn gronden aan weerszijden van wateren die gevrijwaard dienen te worden van werken en ingrepen die het onderhoud van water, oever en oeverbeschoeiing kunnen belemmeren en de stabiliteit en ecologische toestand van de oeverzone kunnen aantasten. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are transport, vaarweg, vaarwegen, veiligheid, waterweg. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
